title: Showcase 96 #12 DC 1996 Legion of Super-Heroes vs Brainiac Jesse Quick
conditionDescription: Bright, light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Showcase '96 #12 of 12 (Winter 1996), DC Comics - Legion of Super-Heroes vs. Brainiac, plus Jesse Quick and King Faraday. Direct sales, $2.95 cover price.

Back cover: Area 51 (Midway) video game ad.

Condition: bright with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
